about: Every design mock-up, by section, for the gallery at /mockups/ (design/index.html). Add a card here whenever a new mock-up folder lands in design/; `node scripts/mockup-gallery.mjs` refreshes the thumbnails and fails if a folder is missing from this list. Optional `shot`: the address the gallery picture is taken from, when the mock-up's difference is not on its first page.

sections.title: Authors
sections.line: The new top-menu page for the preachers and writers in the library (replacing Topics in the menu bar): four directions built on the library catalogue. Life years and places are hand-entered for now.

cards.title: A · Lifelines
cards.line: Five centuries of lives on one timeline: drag a year cursor and the people alive light up on a small map; compare two lives; follow who taught whom; Spurgeon's dated sermons as a calendar.

cards.title: B · Their world
cards.line: The map is the page: a year slider plays every life across Europe and America, cities gather their people, and the missionaries' journeys cross the world.

cards.title: C · The preached Bible
cards.line: All 1,189 chapters lit by the library's sermons on them; pick a preacher to repaint the Bible, compare voices on one chapter, see the quiet chapters.

cards.title: D · Rearrange
cards.line: One set of 47 people that rearranges itself: by century, by tradition, by how much they left, preacher or writer, and who knew whom.

sections.title: Study · People
sections.line: The people pages' visual overhaul, Moses first: one Moses told as three forties (Acts 7:23, 7:30, 7:36), with the journey map and the timeline as the spine. Brief: Research/People/OVERHAUL.md.

cards.title: David · Two voices
cards.line: The record and David's psalms in counterpoint, joined by harp strings that vibrate as each moment arrives (only psalms whose title names the moment).

cards.title: David · The house of David
cards.line: Saul's and David's houses as a living tree with a year scrubber: sons appear, branches grey at each death, crowns pass; 1 Kings 1 as a drama.

cards.title: David · War table
cards.line: A tilted 3D table of the land played in 27 turns, from the valley of Elah to Absalom's revolt: pieces rise, arcs fly, no borders invented.

cards.title: David · Life helix
cards.line: A WebGL double helix of his 70 years: Samuel–Kings in gold, Chronicles in silver, rungs where they differ, 46 event crystals; drag to turn.

cards.title: A · The road
cards.line: Recommended. The map is the page: a full-width journey map stays in place while you scroll, the route draws itself act by act, and each scene rises over it as a glass panel.

cards.title: B · Three forties
cards.line: A command-deck hero: a 120-year ring split into the three forties; choose an act and its bento tiles (scenes, people, words, places) fill the screen and open in place.

cards.title: C · Cinema
cards.line: Full-screen chapters, each with a large line drawing (bush, sea, mountain, tent, Nebo); scenes slide sideways within a chapter; the full text waits in drawers.

cards.title: D · Constellation
cards.line: Moses at the centre of a field: rings of people, places, moments and words, clockwise in story order; choose any point and its panel opens beside it, lines drawn to everything it touches.

cards.title: E · Face to face
cards.line: His life told only through the conversations Scripture records: voices as presences (the LORD as light, never a figure), a score of every line, ten places, threads to follow; every word quoted from the KJV.

cards.title: F · In his hands
cards.line: A specimen cabinet of the eleven objects Scripture names in his life, each drawn by hand: open a case for every verse about it, follow each through time, and see the one object Scripture measures to scale.

cards.title: G · The long memory
cards.line: All 786 verses that name him as light across the 66 books: Exodus to Deuteronomy blaze, then the echoes to Revelation; sort by how a verse remembers him or who is speaking, only where the words support it.

cards.title: Tribes A · The land
cards.line: A full-screen map: every tribe a constellation of the towns Joshua gives it (Atlas points, no drawn borders), and a history scrubber: allotment, Dan moves north, the kingdom divided, the north carried away, Ezekiel's bands.

cards.title: Tribes B · The camp
cards.line: The tabernacle with the twelve camped round it (Numbers 2), each block a field of dots, one per thousand; toggle Numbers 1 and 26 and watch Simeon shrink; Break camp plays the march of Numbers 10.

cards.title: Tribes C · The family
cards.line: Four mothers as lanes, twelve sons born one by one with the words said at each naming; ribbons cross to the tribes, drawn as wide as the people our data places in each.

cards.title: Tribes D · The ledger
cards.line: Recommended: it draws the brief's own insight. Twenty-five lists as a score, one row per list; Braid turns each tribe into a thread through them; the two blessings as a duet; a fingerprint card per tribe. Keep A's constellation map for the land section.

cards.title: E · The score
cards.line: Round 2, the apostle page (Peter; Paul and Thaddaeus by ?who=). His life as a score: Matthew, Mark, Luke, John, Acts and the letters are staves, every event a note in the harmony's order; drag the playhead or press play and the scene opens above.

cards.title: F · The globe
cards.line: A turning 3D globe of the Roman world: Scripture's journeys as solid arcs, tradition's routes dashed and labelled with who said it and when; scroll and the globe turns to each place, the scene rising beside it.

cards.title: G · The thread
cards.line: Every recorded exchange as a message history, word for word from the KJV with its verse: Jesus in red letters, the apostle on the right; Gospel tabs where the wording differs, tradition as forwarded reports, open questions as polls with no votes.

cards.title: H · The strata
cards.line: The evidence as the picture: four glass plates stacked in 3D, Scripture at the bottom, then early church, later tradition and scholars, each carrying its claims on one life-line; drag to tilt, explode, and drill a core through every layer.

cards.title: Unseen A · The veil
cards.line: Michael, angels and demons page (/people/:id/unseen). Two realms on one screen: Daniel's three weeks of mourning by the river below, the unseen above as a plain diagram of what Daniel 10 says (who withstood, for how many days, who came to help); scrolling lifts a woven veil between them.

cards.title: Unseen B · War in heaven
cards.line: Michael. Revelation 12 as a night-sky chart in fine line: the woman clothed with the sun, the dragon as a figure of stars with seven crowned heads, Michael and his angels as points of light; each verse lights its part, and on a phone the view follows it.

cards.title: Unseen C · Strata
cards.line: Michael. The evidence as a flat geological section: Scripture as bedrock, then Jewish writings outside the Bible, early church, later tradition and scholars, each layer dated; a drill core goes down and every find opens beside it. Close in idea to the apostle set's glass-plate strata.

cards.title: Unseen D · Who is like God?
cards.line: Recommended. Michael. The name as the centrepiece (מִיכָאֵל in its three parts, with the lexicons' meaning), then the whole Bible as one spine to scale with a light wherever he is named: the planned 'where they appear' picture, and it works for every being in scope. War in heaven's line drawing can serve its visions.

sections.title: Atlas · Journeys
sections.line: The Journeys page: person icons, the Your journey area and the route that draws itself.

cards.title: Pilgrim
cards.line: The warm atlas made richer: a dawn-road picture, round icon badges, a chapter timeline that fills as you go.

cards.title: Starlight
cards.line: The journeys as a night sky: constellations shaped like the icons, a wide map with a frosted panel floating over it.

cards.title: Voyage
cards.line: Big and cinematic: ribbons fan out to each person, and the traveller carries a name tag ("To Paphos").

cards.title: Meridian
cards.line: Precise and instrument-like: chapters in a sidebar, a map grid, and a live readout of the leg and the distance.

sections.title: Study · Letters
sections.line: How the Letters study is laid out: one long page, cards and section pages, or a compact top.

cards.title: Layout 1 · One page
cards.line: Paul's letters as one page: the letter picker under the title, then all twelve cards in three rows.

cards.title: Layout 2 · Collections and ways in
cards.line: Four collections and four ways in, each a page of 3 × 4 cards that open section pages. Live on the site.

cards.title: Layout 3 · Compact top
cards.line: A compact top (title, figures, three section cards); the chosen section's four parts sit below.

sections.title: Site · Header
sections.line: The menu bar at the top of every page.

cards.title: Eight header layouts
cards.line: Eight ways to arrange the menu, search and dark mode. Option 2 was chosen: Testimonies set apart in gold, search beside dark mode.

sections.title: Site · Link preview
sections.line: The picture shown when someone shares a link (1200 × 630). Round 2, light mode: the name very large and the sun drawing from the Study page's Topics card.

cards.title: Radiant
cards.line: The sun drawing across the top, "Bible Project" very large beneath.

cards.title: Side by side
cards.line: The name in two very large lines on the left, the sun drawing on the right.

cards.title: Free and open
cards.line: Chosen, round 3 (2026-10-08): the logo 20% taller than the B, the sun drawing larger, a cross either side and four-pointed stars. Round 2 version kept in design/link-preview/round-2.

cards.title: Sunrise
cards.line: The name very large, the sun rising from the bottom edge.
